findings.title: Every request goes through one Decision service
findings.message: It runs 1 replica, and every request from Applications goes through it: if it stops, Applications gets nothing.

output.hint: To fix one, send its fix.ops to edit_diagram as they are (one undo step). Only the person can ignore a finding.

findings.title: Failed messages to Applications are lost
findings.message: Applications fails some of what it's sent, and nothing delivers it again: there's no queue or topic in front of it to redeliver.

output.simulations: Played 4 saved simulations (at most 60 s each).
